::: {#def-postorder}
#### Postorder

The **postorder** $\operatorname{postorder}(T)$ of a binary tree $T$ (@def-binary-tree) [@wikipedia_tree_traversal]
is the list (@def-list) of the labels of its vertices defined recursively by

$$
\ba
\operatorname{postorder}(\mathtt{nil}) &= \mathtt{empty},
\\ \operatorname{postorder}\paren{\operatorname{node}(x, L, R)} &= \operatorname{app}\paren{\operatorname{postorder}(L), \operatorname{app}\paren{\operatorname{postorder}(R), \operatorname{cons}(x, \mathtt{empty})}}.
\ea
$$

The root comes after its subtrees.

:::
